name: Elderwood Bloom
description: Slow-rolls cheap Elderwood units to 3-star while stacking the Elderwood plant buff to 7, then levels to 8 for an Ezreal/LeBlanc dual-carry finish.

carries.itemNotes: Runaan's Hurricane or Statikk Shiv are fine substitutes if crit components aren't open; Ezreal wants attack speed to proc his caster-AD pattern, not raw crit.
Any AP burst item pairs fine; the priority is mana/AP to reset her burst combo as fast as possible.

boardPositioning.notes: Ezreal and LeBlanc sit in opposite back corners so a single dive target can't reach both; Alistar sits just behind the front line so his knockup lands on backline divers instead of the frontline trade.

levelPlan.notes: Roll only if a 2-star 1-cost Elderwood unit is available; otherwise hold.
Start the slow roll here: hold at 6 and roll for Alistar/LeBlanc 3-star.
Roll down for the Elderwood-7 breakpoint (Ezreal, Gnar) and Ezreal/LeBlanc copies.
Continue rolling if HP allows; otherwise bank econ and hold the board.

earlyOpener: Fast to level 4 by 2-1. Greedily pick up any cheap Elderwood or Fae unit you see (Ornn, Xayah, Alistar, LeBlanc) without spending gold to 2-star them yet; play a generic strong early frontline in the meantime and take a neutral econ augment at 2-1 to preserve gold for the slow roll.
pivotNotes: If Alistar and LeBlanc aren't showing or are heavily contested by 3-2, pivot to whichever open 2-cost carry the lobby isn't taking (e.g. a Caitlyn Hunter or Sejuani Juggernaut line) and keep the same Ornn/Hecarim frontline, since both slot into most frontlines without a reset.
